blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Several areas suspended face-to-face classes on Wednesday, Oct. 28, due to health concerns and preparations for the first Bangsamoro Parliament session and Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) meetings. Below are the following areas with in-person class suspensions: Lapu-Lapu City – shift to asynchronous learning modes until Oct. 30 in schools in Brgy. Ibo, Buaya, Mactan, and P. Engaño, and in selected educational institutions and universities: The Lapu-Lapu City government said it implemented the temporary learning arrangement from Oct. 26 to 30 as the city hosts the 20th Asean Defense Ministers’ Meeting (ADMM) and 13th ADMM-Plus and related […]...
